title: Caddy: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2025-27144)
description: CVE-2025-27144 is a high-severity security vulnerability affecting the caddy package, specifically in its use of the Go JOSE library which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability impacts versions prior to 2.8.4-r0, 2.9.1-r1, and 2.8.4-r1. A fix is available in these versions.
